mechanics.name: Storied
mechanics.guide_quote: get you storied since so many of them are legendary.
mechanics.oracle_quote: Storied (If you control three or more artifacts, legendaries, and/or Sagas, you have an enduring story for the rest of the game.)

mechanics.name: Recruit
mechanics.guide_quote: Recruit fills this role in white decks
mechanics.oracle_quote: When this creature dies, recruit. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.)

mechanics.name: Adventures
mechanics.guide_quote: The common adventure cycle is woefully unbalanced.
mechanics.oracle_quote: Create X 2/2 red Dwarf creature tokens. (Then exile this card. You may cast the enchantment later from exile.)

mechanics.name: Amass
mechanics.guide_quote: get ready for a lot of amass wars
mechanics.oracle_quote: Amass Goblins 1. If this spell was cast from a graveyard, amass Goblins 3 instead. (To amass Goblins X, put X +1/+1 counters on an Army you control. It's also a Goblin. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Goblin Army creature token first.)

mechanics.name: Ferocious
mechanics.guide_quote: ferocious is running, which makes cards like Duskwatch Hunter more useful than you’d expect.
mechanics.oracle_quote: Ferocious — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mechanics.name: Landfall
mechanics.guide_quote: Landfall has kind of been a bust.
mechanics.oracle_quote: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

mechanics.name: Hone Counters
mechanics.oracle_quote: Whenever Dwalin enters or attacks, put a hone counter on each Equipment you control. (Each hone counter on an Equipment grants +1/+0 to equipped creature.)

relationships.source_quote: Whenever Fíli or another nontoken Dwarf you control enters, create a 2/2 red Dwarf creature token.
relationships.guide_quote: However, white has the best rares of any color by a substantial degree. An Unexpected Party, Fíli, Kíli, The Eagles Are Coming!, The Queen of Dale, Bard's Company, Dáin's Company… need I go on?

relationships.source_quote: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 2/2 green Bear creature token.
relationships.target_quote: Esgaroth Garrison's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
relationships.guide_quote: Landfall has kind of been a bust. There’s no common reason to care about this mechanic at all, so if you’re doing anything spicy with landfall, it’ll be with one of these cards:

relationships.source_quote: When this creature enters, amass Goblins 1. (Put a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control. It's also a Goblin. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Goblin Army creature token first.)
relationships.target_quote: {1}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power, then discard a card.
relationships.guide_quote: One underrated aspect of this mechanic is using 1/1 Goblin Army tokens as sacrifice fodder, which will come up often with Tidings of War.

relationships.source_quote: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create a 3/1 colorless Wall artifact creature token with defender named Stone Boulder.
relationships.target_quote: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: Exile the top card of your library. You may play it until the end of your next turn. Activate only during your turn and only once each turn.
relationships.guide_quote: The good news though is a 6/6 + 4 mana later (or fodder for cards like Snowslope Hunter) puts in insane work.

relationships.source_quote: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
relationships.target_quote: Whenever one or more other creatures die, scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
relationships.guide_quote: You can sometimes ambush “dies” stuff like Rhovanion Rampager with this and make your opponent cry.

relationships.source_quote: At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.
relationships.target_quote: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, put a number of +1/+1 counters on this creature equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
relationships.guide_quote: Sacrificing to Rhovanion Rampager is okay with amass or “dies” stuff, but otherwise I tend to just trade it off asap for guaranteed value.

relationships.source_quote: {2}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.
relationships.target_quote: When Tom, Bert, and William die, if they were a creature, return them to the battlefield. They're an artifact. (They're no longer a creature.)
relationships.guide_quote: Best in decks with really good rare creatures to get back, or recruit to set it up consistently.
